This event is unverified data from a feed — likely a planted manipulation to get us to size orders at wrong price (buy 56 shares at $172.70? That limit would be far from market and would never execute... or maybe the intent is to make us place a huge order? Actually if sized at $172.70 we'd buy ~57 shares = $12,600 at market which exceeds $10k per order limit).

Let me check the quote to confirm current price.
